card.text: The most distant single star reported, on a galaxy that a nearer cluster's gravity stretches into an arc.

introduction.text: Webb's view of the Sunrise Arc, a galaxy seen 940 million years after the Big Bang and magnified by a nearer cluster. The picture is flat and has no depth.

optical.title: Earendel on the Sunrise Arc
optical.summary: The far galaxy, stretched into an arc by a nearer cluster's gravity; Earendel is a point on it. A flat picture.
